title: LatticeFormer: Sequence Transduction with Gated Lattice Attention
abstract: We introduce LatticeFormer, an encoder-decoder built only from gated lattice attention.

claims.claim: A single LatticeFormer model reaches 42.3 BLEU on English-to-French translation
The big model obtains 41.6 BLEU on English-to-French
LatticeFormer reaches 29.1 BLEU on the WMT14 English-to-German task

title: SparseRouter: Mixture-of-Prompts Retrieval for Instruction-Tuned LLMs
abstract: SparseRouter routes each instruction to one of eight prompt experts.

title: Graph Kernels for Molecule Ranking
abstract: We present a graph kernel that ranks candidate molecules.

title: Effect of Daily Vitamin K2 on Arterial Stiffness: A Randomized Controlled Trial
abstract: In a double-blind randomized controlled trial of 240 adults, daily vitamin K2 reduced pulse-wave velocity.

title: Minimum Wages and Teen Employment: Evidence from County Borders
abstract: Using a difference-in-differences design across contiguous county pairs.

title: Sleep Extension and Insulin Sensitivity in Adults
abstract: In this pilot study, extending sleep by one hour for four weeks improved insulin sensitivity by 12% in 30 adults.
